components.description: Position, rotation and scale relative to the parent entity
components.name: Transform

properties.Description: Edited as Euler angles in degrees
properties.Name: Rotation

components.description: Gameplay label used to find groups of entities
components.name: Tag

components.description: Links this entity to the prefab it was created from
components.name: PrefabInstance

properties.Description: Vertical field of view in degrees
properties.Name: PerspectiveFOV

properties.Description: Vertical extent in world units
properties.Name: OrthographicSize

properties.Description: The first active primary camera renders the game view
properties.Name: Primary

properties.Description: Blurs what lies nearer or farther than the focus, as a camera's lens does (perspective cameras); players can turn it off
properties.Name: DepthOfField

properties.Description: Meters from the camera to the sharpest plane
properties.Name: FocusDistance

properties.Description: Keeps this entity in focus (its distance along the camera's view, at least the near plane); none: Focus Distance
properties.Name: FocusEntity

properties.Description: The lens's f-number: lower blurs more (f/1.4 a portrait lens wide open), higher keeps more in focus (f/16)
properties.Name: Aperture

properties.Description: Millimeters: with the field of view it sets the focal length; larger sensors blur more at the same view (24 full frame, 15.6 APS-C, 8.8 a 1-inch sensor)
properties.Name: SensorHeight

properties.Description: Overrides every submesh material when set
properties.Name: Material

components.description: Sun-like light shining along the entity's forward (-Z) direction; its intensity is illuminance in lux
components.name: DirectionalLight

properties.Description: Linear color of the light, times Intensity: (1, 1, 1) for the midday sun; the physical atmosphere dims and reddens it toward the horizon itself, so tint it only for a look
properties.Name: Color

properties.Description: Illuminance in lux on a surface facing the light, times Color: direct sun about 100,000, an overcast day 1,000 to 10,000, a full moon 0.25
properties.Name: Intensity

properties.Description: Angular diameter of the light's disk in degrees (the sun: about 0.53; an overcast sky's soft sun up to 10): its shadows' penumbra widens with the distance from the caster, and its highlight on smooth surfaces takes the disk's size. 0: the hardest shadow the filter allows and a point-like highlight
properties.Name: ShadowSoftness

properties.Description: Whether the light casts shadows: cascaded shadow maps out to Shadow Distance, their resolution and number set by Project Settings > Graphics Quality
properties.Name: CastShadows

properties.Description: Meters from the camera the shadows reach; the last cascade fades out before it. Shorter spends the same shadow-map texels on less ground: sharper near shadows
properties.Name: ShadowDistance

properties.Description: Depth offset toward the light in shadow-map texels: raise it against shadow acne (stripes on lit surfaces), lower it when shadows detach from their casters
properties.Name: ShadowBias

properties.Description: Offset of the lookup along the surface normal in shadow-map texels: raise it against acne on surfaces at grazing angles to the light
properties.Name: ShadowNormalBias

properties.Description: Fraction of each shadow cascade's depth range over which it blends into the next one, hiding the seams between them; the last one fades out by the Shadow Distance. 0 switches at once
properties.Name: CascadeBlend

properties.Description: Meters toward the light over which contact shadows ground objects smaller than the shadow cascades' texels, when Graphics Quality's Contact Shadows has steps (Custom; no preset draws them); 0 off
properties.Name: ContactShadowLength

properties.Description: How the cascades share the distance from 1.5 m to the Shadow Distance: 0 evenly, 1 each cascade the same ratio farther than the previous. Higher puts more detail near the camera
properties.Name: CascadeDistribution

components.description: Light shining in every direction from the entity's position, with shadows in six directions when it casts them; its intensity is luminous intensity in candela
components.name: PointLight

properties.Description: Luminous intensity in candela, times Color, falling off with the square of the distance: a bulb of P lumens has P / 12.57 cd (800 lm, about 64 cd), a candle about 1
properties.Name: Intensity

properties.Description: Light fades to zero at this distance
properties.Name: Range

properties.Description: Radius in meters of the light's bulb or flame: smooth and wet surfaces show its highlight at that size, the same light spread wider (a lantern about 0.05, a fire about 0.25). Its diffuse light and shadows do not change. 0: a point
properties.Name: SourceRadius

properties.Description: Casts shadows: the renderer gives the most relevant shadowed lights in view (16) tiles of its shadow atlas, six for a point light, one for a spot light; each costs drawing its casters again when they move
properties.Name: CastShadows

properties.Description: Depth offset toward the light, in texels of the light's shadow tiles: raise it if lit surfaces show stripes of shadow (acne)
properties.Name: ShadowBias

properties.Description: Offset along the surface normal, in texels of the light's shadow tiles: raise it against acne on surfaces lit at grazing angles; too much detaches shadows from their casters
properties.Name: ShadowNormalBias

properties.Description: Radius of the shadow's soft edge, in texels of the light's shadow tiles (0 to 8)
properties.Name: ShadowFilterRadius

components.description: Cone light shining along the entity's forward (-Z) direction, with shadows when it casts them; its intensity is luminous intensity in candela along its axis
components.name: SpotLight

properties.Description: Luminous intensity in candela along the axis, times Color, falling off with the square of the distance; a narrower cone does not make it brighter
properties.Name: Intensity

properties.Description: Radius in meters of the light's bulb or flame: smooth and wet surfaces show its highlight at that size, the same light spread wider (a lantern about 0.05, a fire about 0.25). Its diffuse light and shadows do not change. 0: a point
properties.Name: SourceRadius

properties.Description: Half angle in degrees
properties.Name: InnerConeAngle

properties.Description: Half angle in degrees
properties.Name: OuterConeAngle

properties.Description: Casts shadows: the renderer gives the most relevant shadowed lights in view (16) tiles of its shadow atlas, six for a point light, one for a spot light; each costs drawing its casters again when they move
properties.Name: CastShadows

properties.Description: Depth offset toward the light, in texels of the light's shadow tiles: raise it if lit surfaces show stripes of shadow (acne)
properties.Name: ShadowBias

properties.Description: Offset along the surface normal, in texels of the light's shadow tiles: raise it against acne on surfaces lit at grazing angles; too much detaches shadows from their casters
properties.Name: ShadowNormalBias

properties.Description: Radius of the shadow's soft edge, in texels of the light's shadow tiles (0 to 8)
properties.Name: ShadowFilterRadius

components.description: Rectangle light shining along the entity's forward (-Z) direction from its X-Y plane, lighting every pixel with its face's diffuse light and highlight; its intensity is the luminance of its face in nits, or its power in lumens
components.name: RectLight

properties.Description: Linear color of the light, times Intensity
properties.Name: Color

properties.Description: Luminance of the face in nits (cd/m²), times Color, with Units Nits (an LED ceiling panel about 3,000, a lit sign 1,000, a softbox 10,000); its power in lumens with Units Lumens (an LED panel of 60 x 60 cm about 3,600 lm)
properties.Name: Intensity

properties.Description: Nits: Intensity is the face's luminance, as an emissive material's (resizing keeps its brightness); Lumens: the power the light emits, spread over its face (resizing keeps its power; a two-sided light shares it between its faces)
properties.Name: Units

properties.Description: Meters along the entity's X axis, times its scale
properties.Name: Width

properties.Description: Meters along the entity's Y axis, times its scale
properties.Name: Height

properties.Description: Emits from both faces. Nits: each face has the Intensity's luminance (twice the power); Lumens: the faces share the power (each half as bright)
properties.Name: TwoSided

properties.Description: Light fades to zero at this distance from the rectangle
properties.Name: Range

properties.Description: Soft shadows, filtered with the light's own size: sharp where an object meets the floor, wider further away. Takes six views of the local shadow atlas (five for a one-sided ceiling panel) from Max Shadowed Local Lights' budget
properties.Name: CastShadows

properties.Description: Depth offset toward the light, in texels of the light's shadow tiles: raise it if lit surfaces show stripes of shadow (acne)
properties.Name: ShadowBias

properties.Description: Offset along the surface normal, in texels of the light's shadow tiles: raise it against acne on surfaces lit at grazing angles; too much detaches shadows from their casters
properties.Name: ShadowNormalBias

components.description: Marks this emissive mesh as the face of an area light (Make Area Light adds it): screen-space reflections, reflection probe captures and area lights' shadows leave its emission out, so the panel is not counted twice. The mesh still draws, casts the sun's and other lights' shadows and is picked as before
components.name: LightSurface

components.description: Image-based lighting and sky background from an HDR environment map, a procedural sky or a physical atmosphere lit by the directional light; its radiance is luminance in nits (cd/m²) times its intensity (the atmosphere's: per lux of the light's illuminance)
components.name: SkyLight

properties.Description: EnvironmentMap: an HDR texture; Procedural: a sky computed from the colors below and the directional light; Atmosphere: Earth's sky lit by the directional light, which it dims and reddens toward the horizon
properties.Name: Source

properties.Description: Equirectangular HDR texture
properties.Name: EnvironmentMap

properties.Description: Multiplies the sky's luminance in nits (cd/m²): an environment map's values, the procedural colors, the ambient color, and the atmosphere's sky (nits per lux of the directional light)
properties.Name: Intensity

properties.Description: Degrees around +Y (environment maps only)
properties.Name: Rotation

properties.Description: Ambient sky luminance in nits (linear, times Intensity) while there is no environment (no map set)
properties.Name: AmbientColor

properties.Description: Procedural sky: luminance straight up in nits (linear, times Intensity)
properties.Name: ZenithColor

properties.Description: Procedural sky: luminance at the horizon in nits (linear, times Intensity)
properties.Name: HorizonColor

properties.Description: Procedural sky: luminance below the horizon in nits (linear, times Intensity)
properties.Name: GroundColor

properties.Description: Procedural sky and atmosphere: angular diameter of the sun's disk in degrees (0 hides it)
properties.Name: SunSize

properties.Description: Procedural sky: luminance of the sun's disk in nits, times the directional light's color (not its intensity) and this sky's Intensity
properties.Name: SunIntensity

properties.Description: Atmosphere: density of its air and aerosols (1: Earth's); thicker air reddens the sun sooner
properties.Name: AtmosphereDensity

properties.Description: Atmosphere: amount of aerosols (1: a clear day), the whitish haze and glow around the sun
properties.Name: AtmosphereHaze

properties.Description: Atmosphere: diffuse reflectance of the planet's ground, which lights the sky from below
properties.Name: GroundAlbedo

properties.Description: Atmosphere: distant surfaces fade into the air's haze, as the sky does (aerial perspective)
properties.Name: AerialPerspective

properties.Description: Atmosphere: distances multiplied by this for the haze: 1 is Earth's air, 4 makes a 1 km view look like 4 km
properties.Name: AerialPerspectiveScale

components.description: Fog that thickens toward the ground, over the scene's surfaces and its sky (the first active one applies)
components.name: HeightFog

properties.Description: Extinction per meter at the base height: 0.02 hides half of what lies 35 m away
properties.Name: Density

properties.Description: Per meter: the density falls by the factor e every 1 / falloff meters above the base height and rises below it
properties.Name: HeightFalloff

properties.Description: World height in meters where the density is Density
properties.Name: BaseHeight

properties.Description: Meters from the camera before which there is no fog
properties.Name: StartDistance

properties.Description: The most the fog hides of what lies behind it; the sky at the horizon gets this much
properties.Name: MaxOpacity

properties.Description: Linear albedo: the fraction of its light the fog scatters toward the viewer
properties.Name: Color

properties.Description: The sky lights the fog: the procedural sky's horizon color, an environment map's light from above, or the ambient color without either; off, Color is the fog's own radiance. The directional light lights it either way
properties.Name: ColorFromSky

properties.Description: How strongly the fog scatters the directional light toward a viewer looking at it: 0 equally in every direction, 1 into a glow around the light
properties.Name: SunScattering

components.description: Reflections and ambient light inside a box from a capture of the scene around the entity (lighting.bakeProbes renders it); where boxes overlap the two strongest blend
components.name: ReflectionProbe

properties.Description: Equirectangular HDR texture of the scene seen from the probe (luminance in nits): Bake writes one
properties.Name: Capture

properties.Description: Half size of the influence box in meters, along the entity's axes (times its scale)
properties.Name: Extents

properties.Description: Meters inside the box's faces over which the probe fades into the sky's lighting (or a weaker probe's)
properties.Name: BlendDistance

properties.Description: Reflections are projected onto the box's faces, so walls near the box's faces reflect where they are (rooms); off, the capture is seen as if infinitely far (open spaces)
properties.Name: BoxProjection

properties.Description: Multiplies the capture's luminance
properties.Name: Intensity

properties.Description: Where boxes overlap the higher priority wins (then the smaller box); with more probes in view than the renderer keeps, the strongest stay
properties.Name: Priority

components.description: Tonemapping, exposure, bloom, ambient occlusion, anti-aliasing and screen-space reflection settings
components.name: PostProcess

properties.Description: Filmic: the engine's camera-like curve, middle gray shown as middle gray, a soft shoulder that takes bright colors to white without changing their hue (Toe and Shoulder shape it); ACES: punchier, darker mid-tones (needs about +0.8 EV for the same brightness); AgX: flatter and less saturated; Khronos Neutral: keeps base colors up to the highlights; Reinhard; None: the exposed colors clipped
properties.Name: Tonemapper

properties.Description: Exposure compensation in EV
properties.Name: Exposure

properties.Description: Adapts the exposure to the scene's brightness over time, as an eye or a camera's meter does, within Auto Exposure Min and Max EV; off, Exposure alone sets it
properties.Name: AutoExposure

properties.Description: Darkest average scene luminance (log2) automatic exposure brightens up to
properties.Name: AutoExposureMinEV

properties.Description: Brightest average scene luminance (log2) automatic exposure darkens down to
properties.Name: AutoExposureMaxEV

properties.Description: How fast the exposure follows a darker scene (the image brightens), per second; 0 jumps at once
properties.Name: AutoExposureSpeed

properties.Description: A soft glow around bright light: the light a camera's lens scatters
properties.Name: Bloom

properties.Description: Fraction of the light scattered into the glow
properties.Name: BloomIntensity

properties.Description: Only light brighter than this (after exposure) blooms; 0 = all light, physically based
properties.Name: BloomThreshold

properties.Description: Darkens creases, corners and contacts that ambient light reaches less (screen-space ambient occlusion)
properties.Name: AmbientOcclusion

properties.Description: Meters: how far around a surface occluders darken it; on screen kept between 0.3% and 12% of the view's height
properties.Name: AmbientOcclusionRadius

properties.Description: How strongly the occlusion darkens ambient light: 1 as measured, 0 none, above 1 stronger
properties.Name: AmbientOcclusionIntensity

properties.Description: Occluded corners of bright surfaces keep the light their walls reflect into them: white plaster stays light in its creases, dark soil darkens fully
properties.Name: AmbientOcclusionMultiBounce

properties.Description: Experimental. Bounce light and sky occlusion traced in the world around the camera: sunlit floors light the walls, colored surfaces tint their neighbors, closed rooms stay dark, whether the source is on screen or not. Graphics Quality High and Ultra; off at Low and Medium
properties.Name: GlobalIllumination

properties.Description: How much of the traced indirect light shades surfaces: 1 as traced
properties.Name: GlobalIlluminationIntensity

properties.Description: Smooths jagged edges, by the method below
properties.Name: AntiAliasing

properties.Description: FXAA: fast approximate anti-aliasing of each frame; TAA: temporal anti-aliasing, each frame sampled at another sub-pixel offset and blended with the earlier ones along their motion: smoother, steadier edges and thin details, and point and spot lights' soft shadow edges without their grain (the sun's are the same with any method). TAA Preset chooses how the TAA looks. Morphological: non-temporal, finds edges and blends along them, keeping texture detail
properties.Name: AntiAliasingMethod

properties.Description: How the TAA looks. Sharp: tighter history clipping, slow pans resampled less, uncovered surfaces drop their history, transparent surfaces take mostly the current frame, a faster response to motion and a light sharpening of the displayed image. Original: the first TAA, softer and steadier. Custom: the tunables below (choosing it in the Inspector starts from the look in effect)
properties.Name: TAAPreset

properties.Description: About how many frames the image averages: the current frame weighs at least 1 / this. At 8, every jitter position counts once. More is smoother and steadier but lags behind lighting changes; fewer reacts faster but edges crawl
properties.Name: TAAHistoryFrames

properties.Description: How quickly moving surfaces let go of the history. At 0.0625, motion of 8 pixels a frame weighs the current frame 0.5. Higher keeps moving things crisper and their trails shorter, but they get less anti-aliasing while they move. 0: motion does not matter
properties.Name: TAAMotionResponse

properties.Description: The most the current frame weighs, however fast things move. 1 lets very fast motion drop the history: sharp, but aliased
properties.Name: TAAMaxMotionWeight

properties.Description: The current frame's least weight where the history is read between pixels, as in slow pans; it is largest halfway between them. Higher keeps slowly moving texture crisper, but its edges get less anti-aliasing while they move. 0: off
properties.Name: TAAResampleWeight

properties.Description: How the history is kept consistent with what the pixel shows now. Range limits it to the range of the colors around the pixel. Tight limits it to a narrower box around their average, which removes more ghosting and trails, most where the surroundings are smooth and less beside glints
properties.Name: TAAHistoryClamp

properties.Description: Tight only: the box's half width, in standard deviations of the colors around the pixel. Lower removes more trails, but lets edges flicker and lets noise through
properties.Name: TAAClipWidth

properties.Description: The current frame's least weight where a blended transparent surface covers the pixel (half cover or more counts as full). Transparent surfaces have no motion vectors of their own. 0 treats them like everything else, so they ghost when they move; 1 drops their history, so they never ghost, but their edges shimmer
properties.Name: TAATransparentWeight

properties.Description: Drop the history where a surface was just uncovered (something nearer covered it in the previous frame), so moving objects leave no ghost on what they uncover
properties.Name: TAADisocclusionRejection

properties.Description: How much nearer the previous frame's surface must have been, as a fraction of the distance, for the pixel to count as uncovered. Lower catches thin gaps, such as a hand in front of a wall, but may drop the history of surfaces moving fast away from the camera
properties.Name: TAADisocclusionThreshold

properties.Description: Sharpens the displayed image after TAA, never the history, to restore texture detail the averaging softens. Strong edges are sharpened much less and overshoot is bounded, so halos stay faint. 0 is off
properties.Name: TAASharpening

properties.Description: Reflections of what the screen shows, found each frame: smooth floors, water and metal reflect what stands near them. At Graphics Quality Medium (Reflections Checkerboard) only with TAA; High and Ultra trace every pixel with or without it. Where they find nothing (off screen, hidden, the sky) the reflection probes and the sky reflect as before
properties.Name: ScreenSpaceReflections

properties.Description: How much the screen-space reflections replace the probes' and the sky's reflection where they find something; 1: fully
properties.Name: ScreenSpaceReflectionsIntensity

properties.Description: Surfaces rougher than this get none, and they fade out over the last quarter below it: rough surfaces blur what they reflect, which screen-space reflections do not
properties.Name: ScreenSpaceReflectionsMaxRoughness

properties.Description: Natural darkening toward the image's corners, as a lens's (cos^4 of the field angle): 0 none, 1 a lens's full fall-off; 0.12 darkens the corners of a 60 degree view by about 10%
properties.Name: Vignette

properties.Description: Color saturation after the tone curve: 1 unchanged, 0 gray, 2 twice as vivid
properties.Name: Saturation

properties.Description: Around middle gray; 1 = unchanged
properties.Name: Contrast

properties.Description: How deep the shadows go: higher crushes the darkest tones toward black, lower keeps more detail in them (Filmic only)
properties.Name: Toe

properties.Description: How softly highlights roll off to white: higher reaches white more stops above middle gray (5 at 0, 6.5 at 0.5, 8 at 1), keeping more highlight detail (Filmic only)
properties.Name: Shoulder

properties.Description: Temperature in kelvin of the light that shows as white: lower values cool the image (3200 for tungsten light), higher warm it; 6500 is neutral
properties.Name: WhiteBalanceTemperature

properties.Description: Tint: positive adds magenta, negative green
properties.Name: WhiteBalanceTint

properties.Description: Slope: per-channel gain before the tone curve
properties.Name: ColorSlope

properties.Description: Offset: light added per channel, in fractions of middle gray (tints the shadows most)
properties.Name: ColorOffset

properties.Description: Power: per-channel contrast around middle gray
properties.Name: ColorPower

properties.Description: How the image is metered: Average weighs every pixel alike; CenterWeighted counts the middle of the image most and its edges a quarter, as a camera's center-weighted meter
properties.Name: AutoExposureMetering

properties.Description: The darkest share of the metered pixels that is ignored, so deep shadows do not move the exposure
properties.Name: AutoExposureLowPercentile

properties.Description: The brightest share of the metered pixels below this is kept: the pixels above it (light sources) do not move the exposure
properties.Name: AutoExposureHighPercentile

properties.Description: How fast it follows a brighter scene (the image darkens), per second, as eyes leaving a tunnel; 0 jumps at once
properties.Name: AutoExposureLightSpeed

properties.Description: How much a scene's brightness against a gray card in the sun shows: 0 meters every scene to middle gray; 0.12 shows an interior 5 stops below the sun's card 0.6 stops darker (at most 2); scenes above the card are not brightened. Needs a directional light
properties.Name: AutoExposureKey

properties.Description: How far the glow reaches, as a fraction of the image height: the same share of the image at every resolution
properties.Name: BloomRadius

properties.Description: Blurs what moves on screen over the shutter's share of each frame, as a film camera does; editor views never blur, and players can turn it off
properties.Name: MotionBlur

properties.Description: How long the shutter stays open, in degrees of the frame: 180 blurs over half a frame's motion, as film cameras do; 0 none
properties.Name: MotionBlurShutterAngle

properties.Description: The longest blur, as a fraction of the image height: 0.02 is 43 pixels at 2160 rows
properties.Name: MotionBlurMaxLength

properties.Description: Film's grain, new every frame, most visible in the mid-tones; 1 spreads them by about 10 codes. Players can turn it off
properties.Name: FilmGrain

properties.Description: A lens's lateral color fringes, red and blue drawn apart toward the corners; 1 shifts each half a pixel at a 3840x2160 image's corners. Players can turn it off
properties.Name: ChromaticAberration

properties.Description: A grade made in another tool (a .cube file's 3D lookup table), applied to the finished image after the tone curve and the saturation. Nothing applies while it loads
properties.Name: ColorLookup

properties.Description: How much of the color lookup's grade shows: 1 all of it, 0.5 halfway between the image and the graded image
properties.Name: ColorLookupIntensity

properties.Description: A lens's flares around very bright light, with restraint: faint tinted ghosts mirrored through the image's center, a halo, and six rays around the sun's disk while it is in view and not covered. 0 none
properties.Name: LensFlare

components.description: Text drawn in screen space (HUD) or in the world
components.name: Text

properties.Description: Normalized viewport position; (0,0) is the top-left corner
properties.Name: ScreenAnchor

properties.Description: Pixel offset from the anchor (+Y down)
properties.Name: ScreenOffset

properties.Description: Reports overlaps without colliding
properties.Name: IsTrigger

properties.Description: Also swept against kinematic and dynamic bodies, for bullets (every dynamic body is swept against static ones anyway)
properties.Name: ContinuousCollision

properties.Description: Collision layer: it collides with the layers the project's layer matrix lets it
properties.Name: Layer

properties.Description: Uses the Mesh Renderer's mesh when unset
properties.Name: Mesh

properties.Description: Non-convex meshes are only supported on static bodies
properties.Name: Convex

components.description: An upright capsule that scripts walk, jump and teleport: it slides along walls, walks up steps and walkable slopes and pushes dynamic bodies; its bottom is the entity's origin
components.name: CharacterController

properties.Description: Total height of the capsule in world units; its bottom is the entity's origin
properties.Name: Height

properties.Description: World units
properties.Name: Radius

properties.Description: Highest step it walks up, and how far it follows the ground down (world units)
properties.Name: StepHeight

properties.Description: Steepest slope it walks up, in degrees from the horizontal
properties.Name: MaxSlopeDegrees

properties.Description: Collision layer: it collides with the layers the project's layer matrix lets it
properties.Name: Layer

properties.Description: Times the scene's gravity
properties.Name: GravityScale

properties.Description: Largest force with which it pushes dynamic bodies, in newtons
properties.Name: PushStrength

properties.Description: A disabled controller neither moves nor collides
properties.Name: Enabled

components.description: Poses the entity's skinned mesh with an animator's joints
components.name: Skin

properties.Description: The entity with the Animator whose pose moves this mesh
properties.Name: Animator

components.description: Plays a skeleton's animations: an animation controller's states, or one clip
components.name: Animator

properties.Description: The joints the animations move (a model's Skeleton)
properties.Name: Skeleton

properties.Description: States, transitions and parameters; without one the animator plays Clip
properties.Name: Controller

properties.Description: The clip played without a controller
properties.Name: Clip

properties.Description: Playback rate; negative plays backwards
properties.Name: Speed

properties.Description: Whether the clip (without a controller) repeats
properties.Name: Loop

properties.Description: Starts playing when the scene starts
properties.Name: PlayOnStart

properties.Description: Moves the entity by the root joint's horizontal motion and turn
properties.Name: ApplyRootMotion

properties.Description: When Visible poses the skeleton only while a renderer draws a mesh it skins or its shadow; one that skins no mesh but moves attached parts poses always
properties.Name: CullingMode

components.description: Places the entity at a joint of an animator's pose (a sword in a hand)
components.name: AttachToJoint

properties.Description: The entity with the Animator
properties.Name: Animator

properties.Description: The joint's name in the animator's skeleton
properties.Name: Joint

components.description: C++ behaviours from the project's script module
components.name: Script

components.description: Makes the scene a world's persistent scene: its cells stream around the streaming sources while it runs
components.name: World

properties.Description: The world whose cells stream (a .stworld asset)
properties.Name: World

properties.Description: Multiplies every layer's streaming distance: lower on devices with less memory
properties.Name: DistanceScale

components.description: A point the world's cells stream around; without an active one, the primary camera is
components.name: StreamingSource

properties.Description: Whether the source streams
properties.Name: Enabled

properties.Description: Streams the cells within this distance on every layer; 0: each layer's streaming distance
properties.Name: Radius

properties.Description: The layers it streams, separated by commas; empty: every enabled layer
properties.Name: Layers

properties.Description: Higher-priority sources' cells load first
properties.Name: Priority

properties.Description: Cells ahead of the source (its -Z axis) load as if this share of the radius nearer
properties.Name: ViewBias

components.description: A screen of game UI: lays its elements out for the screen it is shown on, scaled by its scale mode, and draws them over the scene
components.name: UICanvas

properties.Description: Constant Pixel Size: a canvas unit is Scale Factor pixels; Scale With Screen: the layout keeps the reference resolution's proportions on every screen; Constant Physical Size: a canvas unit is Scale Factor pixels at 96 DPI
properties.Name: ScaleMode

properties.Description: Scale With Screen: the screen size in pixels the layout is designed for
properties.Name: ReferenceResolution

properties.Description: Scale With Screen: 0 follows the screen's width, 1 its height, between them both
properties.Name: MatchWidthOrHeight

properties.Description: Multiplies the scale of the constant modes
properties.Name: ScaleFactor

properties.Description: Left, top, right and bottom insets of the canvas's rect, in canvas units
properties.Name: SafeAreaPadding

properties.Description: Canvases with a higher order draw over the others and get input first
properties.Name: SortOrder

properties.Description: Rect edges and text baselines on whole pixels
properties.Name: PixelSnap

properties.Description: Off: drawn, but never hit by the pointer or reached by navigation (a HUD that never blocks clicks)
properties.Name: ReceivesInput

properties.Description: The selectable focused when keyboard or gamepad navigation starts
properties.Name: FirstSelected

properties.Description: Screen Space: over the scene, laid out for the screen; World Space: a plane in the scene at the entity's transform, Reference Resolution canvas units wide and high, depth-tested like world text
properties.Name: RenderMode

properties.Description: World Space: world units per canvas unit (0.01: a canvas 100 units wide is a meter)
properties.Name: WorldUnitsPerUnit

components.description: The rectangle of a UI element: anchored in its parent's rect, offset and sized in canvas units
components.name: UIRect

properties.Description: Lower anchor in the parent's rect (0, 0 is its top-left corner)
properties.Name: AnchorMin

properties.Description: Upper anchor in the parent's rect (1, 1 is its bottom-right corner)
properties.Name: AnchorMax

properties.Description: The point of the rect Position places, in the rect (0, 0 is its top-left corner)
properties.Name: Pivot

properties.Description: The pivot's offset from the anchor point, in canvas units (+Y down)
